episodes.title: The Desert
episodes.summary: The series opens with Manchester City's fourth Premier League title in 2024. Pep Guardiola warns success is fleeting as defeats bring pressure. They recover to finish top four, but uncertainty remains.

episodes.title: The Rebuild
episodes.summary: The focus shifts to City's boardroom, where owners confront decline and rebuild. De Bruyne's departure and new signings signal change, but Pep must restore City's ruthless edge.

episodes.title: Love and Hugs
episodes.summary: Players reveal pressure as Guardiola rebuilds unity through unconventional methods. A bold rotation backfires, leading to an emotional reaction before Wembley's Carabao Cup Final.

episodes.title: Nothing Is Eternal
episodes.summary: City reel in Arsenal and surge back into the title race with a defining win at the Etihad. One late slip ends the dream. Pep faces his final days as City boss.
